name: Service Nine
desc: Accurate standard sidearm. Every twelfth fired round deals triple damage, even with extended magazines or Infinite Ammo.
art: a cute chunky sci-fi pistol
lv5: VERDICT — Every sixth shot becomes a piercing tracer that marks targets for focused damage.

name: Deadeye
desc: Six heavy, piercing rounds. Critical hits deal triple damage.
art: a gleaming cowboy revolver with neon trim
lv5: SHOWDOWN — Critical hits stun their target; a duel is won by precision, not reloading.

name: Breacher
desc: Seven close-range pellets; recoil pushes you backward. Strong up close.
art: a sawed-off double barrel shotgun
lv5: BREACH KICK — Point-blank pellet hits stagger enemies and blast them backward.

name: Cyclone
desc: High fire rate. Sustained fire gradually tightens bullet spread.
art: a compact submachine gun with drum magazine
lv5: SUPPRESSION — Hits pulse a slowing shockwave into nearby enemies every 0.55 seconds.

name: Vulcan
desc: Spins up into rapid fire. Movement slows while the barrels are spinning.
art: a huge six barrel minigun
lv5: FULL SPOOL — At peak barrel speed, rounds penetrate and sweep targets sideways.

name: Longshot
desc: Pierces six enemies; hits against undamaged targets deal double damage.
art: a long sleek sniper rifle with scope
lv3: Kills fire a free shot at the next target
lv5: COLLATERAL — Every enemy pierced empowers that same round as it travels onward.

name: Payload
desc: Accelerating rockets explode on impact. Strong against clustered enemies.
art: a chunky rocket launcher with a pink rocket
lv5: THERMOBARIC — The initial rocket blast is followed by a telegraphed vacuum that pulls and slows enemies.

name: Rebound
desc: Grenades bounce off walls before exploding. Controls narrow routes.
art: a round cartoon grenade launcher
lv5: SMART BANK — A grenade that hits a wall locks onto a nearby enemy and guides itself home.

name: Prism Beam
desc: Continuous piercing beam; overheats after three seconds of firing.
art: a futuristic laser cannon glowing purple
lv5: PRISMATIC — First contact refracts into two angled damage rays; continuous fire no longer overheats.

name: Arc Caster
desc: Lightning jumps between enemies and applies shock.
art: a tesla coil gun crackling with blue lightning
lv5: STATIC OVERLOAD — Every third target reached by the chain is briefly stunned.

name: Cinder
desc: Close-range cone of fire that always burns its targets.
art: a flamethrower with a fuel tank
lv5: FLASHOVER — Burning targets send branching embers to up to three unburned enemies on death.

name: Razor Disc
desc: Piercing blades fly out and return. Rewards positioning.
art: a glowing razor frisbee disc
lv5: VORTEX RECALL — Returning blades drag nearby enemies into their cutting path.

name: Returner
desc: Heavy boomerang curves back through the crowd.
art: a wooden boomerang with neon paint
lv5: PERFECT CATCH — Catch returning throws to build up to +45% damage for the next throw.

name: Gauss Lance
desc: Hold to charge and repeatedly fire piercing rail strikes. Three charge cells, then reload.
art: a sci-fi railgun with blue energy coils
lv5: ION SCAR — A charged rail strike leaves a shocking lightning corridor for 1.5 seconds.

name: Swarmcaster
desc: Releases homing bees that poison targets.
art: a beehive shaped gun with cartoon bees
lv5: PHEROMONES — Bee stings mark enemies as scent targets, drawing in the rest of the swarm.

name: Impact Cannon
desc: Heavy rounds shove enemies into each other for collision damage.
art: a cannon that shoots bowling balls
lv5: PERFECT STRIKE — Hit three enemies with one ball to throw nearby enemies away in a kinetic wave.

name: Rivet Driver
desc: Rapid nails can pin enemies in place.
art: a yellow construction nail gun
lv5: RIVET TETHER — Pin one enemy and briefly tether a second nearby target in place.

name: Fowl Play
desc: Bouncing projectiles ricochet between targets, then explode.
art: a launcher stuffed with rubber chickens
lv5: POULTRY PANIC — A direct chicken hit panics nearby enemies into attacking their own team.

name: Pressure Pop
desc: Bubbles immobilize enemies and pop for area damage.
art: a toy bubble gun with big soap bubbles
lv5: PRESSURE TRANSFER — Trapped enemies pass their bubble to another victim when it pops, up to two times.

name: Ricochet
desc: Steel rounds rebound off walls and gain damage on each bounce.
art: a pinball cannon with a shiny steel ball
lv5: PERFECT BANK — Each wall bank charges an increasingly powerful stunning knockback on the next hit.

name: Hydra Bow
desc: Crossbow bolts split into fragments on their first impact.
art: a futuristic crossbow with glowing bolts
lv5: HYDRA HUNTERS — Splinter bolts steer toward fresh targets rather than splitting again.

name: Frostcaster
desc: Snowballs grow in flight and build up freeze on contact.
art: a snow cannon shooting snowballs
lv3: Frozen enemies shatter for area damage
lv5: WHITEOUT — Your first snowball impact opens a lingering frost field that chills surrounding enemies.
